episodes.title: Talking about the countryside
episodes.summary: Georgie and Neil have a real conversation in easy English about the countryside – the area outside the cities, where there are more green spaces, plants and wildlife. Learn which word describes somewhere that is full of green, healthy plants and find out Neil and Georgie's favourite countryside locations in the UK.

episodes.summary: Georgie and Neil have a real conversation in easy English about weddings – the ceremonies and parties we organise when people get married. Learn the difference between a stag party and a hen party, and find out what Neil's wedding was like!

episodes.title: Talking about the ocean

episodes.title: Talking about job interviews

episodes.title: Talking about British landmarks
episodes.summary: Georgie and Phil have a real conversation in easy English about British landmarks – famous sights around the United Kingdom. Learn some vocabulary about sightseeing and find out Georgie and Phil's favourite UK landmarks.
